subject: Audit-tail continuity note request for SOC 2 Type II (post-report coverage)
messages:
From: Leah Benton <leah.benton@aurorahealth.com>
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Audit-tail coverage ask for SOC 2 Type II (post-report period)

Hi Jasmine,

Hope you’re doing well. Aurora is finalizing a procurement review and our security team has asked for a short continuity/coverage note to bridge the gap between Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report period (report covers 2026-01-01 through 2026-12-31) and our contract effective date. Specifically we need:

- A one-page continuity memo or signed note confirming there have been no material control changes since 2026-12-31 through 2027-06-17 (or disclose any exceptions).
- A checklist of evidence items you can provide (e.g., recent control change log, incident history, KMS rotation dates, SOC findings closure items).

We’d like to include the memo in our security file by next Wednesday, 23 Jun 2027. If you can provide a timeframe and any fee/PO requirements, that would help move procurement.

I’ve attached the Aurora evidence checklist and our contract intake form. Happy to discuss on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Leah Benton
Senior Security Analyst
Aurora Health
leah.benton@aurorahealth.com
Attachments: audit-tail-evidence-checklist.xlsx, procurement-intake-form.pdf
From: jasmine.liu@redwood.com
To: leah.benton@aurorahealth.com
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit-tail coverage ask for SOC 2 Type II (post-report period)

Hi Leah — thanks for the clear note and the checklist. We can provide a short continuity memo signed by our Head of Security that: confirms the SOC 2 report period (2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31), states that there have been no material control changes since the report end date through the requested date (2027-06-17), and lists the categories of evidence we can surface.

A few logistics/questions:
- Draft timeline: 3 business days to produce a draft memo, then legal sign-off may add 1 business day. Target delivery: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 (draft) / Wed, 23 Jun 2027 (signed) — aligns with your request.
- Evidence: we can provide the items on your checklist. Please confirm which of the following you need prioritized: KMS rotation logs, incident/IR summary, recent change-control approvals, and SOC findings closure log.
- PO/fee: we typically handle continuity memos without a charge for active customers mid-stage in procurement, but if Procurement needs a purchase order or DocuSign SOW for attestation work we can handle it — share PO number if required.

Looping in Vivek (enterprise lead) and Marcus (security ops) to confirm scope and any ops constraints. Once we align, I’ll attach a draft template for your review.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com
Attachments: audit-tail-draft-template.docx
From: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit-tail coverage ask for SOC 2 Type II (post-report period)

Thanks for taking point, Jasmine. Quick notes from my side:

- Approved to proceed with a short continuity memo — keep language factual and avoid implying an extension of the SOC engagement. Phrase should be: "Redwood Inference confirms that, to the best of its knowledge, there have been no material changes to the control environment since the SOC 2 Type II report period end date (2026-12-31) through the date of this memo."
- Marcus: please prepare the incident summary and the control-change log (redacted as needed) and flag any items that would require qualification.
- Legal: we should route final wording to Legal for sign-off; Jasmine, please coordinate.
- Procurement: if Aurora requires a PO for administrative processing, we can accept one; otherwise no charge for the memo itself.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
From: Leah Benton <leah.benton@aurorahealth.com>
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@aurorahealth.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit-tail coverage ask for SOC 2 Type II (post-report period)

Jasmine/Team — perfect, thanks for the fast turnaround.

We confirm the priority evidence requests are: (1) incident summary (past 12 months) redacted as necessary, (2) KMS rotation dates for active keys, (3) control-change log covering Jan–Jun 2027, and (4) the one-page continuity memo signed by Head of Security.

Procurement has opened PO# AUR-77821 and is ready to route a DocuSign cover if you need it: https://redwood-inference.app/docusign/AAKJ-3344. No charge expected but we’ll include the PO for our records.

If you can get a draft to us by Tue 22 Jun EOD, we’ll prioritize sign-off on our side and close the procurement loop. Appreciate the quick coordination.

Best,
Leah Benton
Senior Security Analyst
Aurora Health
Attachments: none
